steps: num_0 <- CalculateMaxGrid(p_max,p_min,r_0)
num <- min{num_in,num_0}
Calculate price of each grid
Initialize portfolio on first day
t <- T_start+1
if p^t > p^{t-1} && Cross k grids: a^t <- Sell k units
else if p^t < p^{t-1} && Cross k grids: a^t <- Buy k units
else a^t <- Hold
if t <= T_end go back to Step6
End
